newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Rothmans says discounting a concern.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Rothmans says discounting a concern.

text.p: Cigarette manufacturer Rothmans Holdings Ltd said on Friday that recent deep discounting in some segments of the Australian market provided some concern for the second half of the year.
Rothmans earlier reported a jump in net profit to A$52.06 million in the six months to September 30 from A$110,000 in the previous corresponding half.
The company said the discounts remained a concern despite the price stability that had prevailed in most markets.
Rothmans also pointed to an increase in Queensland licence fees to 100 percent from 75 percent but said the resultant impact on cigarette volumes was uncertain at this stage.
Rothman's shares closed 10 cents higher at A$8.20 on turnover of 217,000 shares.

Rothmans is about 50 percent owned by Rothmans International Ltd which in turn is 60 percent owned by Swiss-based Richemont AG RIFZ.Z and 40 percent by South African group Rembrandt Group Ltd. -- Sydney Newsroom 61-2 9373-1800
